title: Why Do Onions Make You Cry?
short_title: Why Do Onions Make You Cry? (And How to Stop It)
description: Cutting an onion makes you cry because of a gas the onion makes when its cells break. Here is the simple science, and two tricks that really help.
tags: why do onions make you cry
comment: What is your best trick to stop crying while cutting onions?

scenes.text: Why does cutting an onion make you cry, when you are not even sad?
Inside an onion, two things are kept apart in separate compartments: a sulfur-rich chemical and a special enzyme.
When your knife cuts the cells, they burst, and the two mix. Together they make a gas that floats up toward your face.
The gas touches the water on your eyes and turns into a mild acid that stings. Your eyes panic and make tears to wash it away.
Two tricks help: chill the onion first, and use a really sharp knife, so fewer cells get crushed.
